shots.subject: Clear lake water lapping over smooth round pebbles at the shoreline, cool early light on the stones and the misty far shore softly blurred
shots.composition: Standing two metres from the waterline looking slightly down; the wet edge of the water runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, dry pebbles above the line and clear shallows below, with a slice of blurred far shore at the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the clear water lapping over the pebbles

shots.subject: A clump of white cottongrass on the edge of an alpine tarn backlit by low sun, its heads glowing against the dark water
shots.composition: Camera at knee height facing the low sun; the glowing cottongrass clump fills the left half three metres away, the dark water behind is softly out of focus and the sun is just outside the top edge. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the cottongrass heads swaying and the glints on the dark water

shots.subject: A lichen-covered granite boulder at the waterline with warm low light raking across its surface and the lake glinting behind
shots.composition: The boulder sits in the right two thirds of the frame about three metres away, its top above the horizon line, and a soft slice of glinting lake and far shore fills the left. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the glinting ripples at the waterline around the boulder

shots.subject: A low larch branch with soft golden needles leaning over still lake water at a rocky shore, pale mist hanging over the surface beyond
shots.composition: The branch enters from the upper left and reaches across the frame two metres from the camera, the still water below it and the mist dissolving the background. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the larch needles stirring and the mist hanging over the water

shots.subject: A thin rim of new ice clinging to dark stones at a lake edge, a dusting of snow on the rocks and dark open water rippling just beyond
shots.composition: Looking down at the shore from standing height; the white ice rim runs as a diagonal line from the lower right to the upper left, snowy stones on one side and dark water on the other. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the dark water rippling beyond the ice rim

shots.subject: A dense mat of wet heather and juniper on a lakeside rock covered in raindrops, a narrow sliver of grey lake at the top
shots.composition: The heather and juniper mat fills the whole frame from a metre away, slightly from above, leaving only a thin strip of grey lake along the top edge. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the heather sprigs trembling in the breeze and the ripples on the sliver of lake

shots.subject: A clump of deep olive-green sedge blades rising from shallow lake water, their reflections doubling them and a faint mist on the water behind
shots.composition: Camera close to the water surface; the sedge clump stands in the centre four metres away with its reflection below, and the misty water forms a plain soft background. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the sedge blades swaying and the faint ripples around their stems

shots.subject: Soft ripples crossing over a bed of rounded grey and olive-brown submerged stones in a shaded mountain lake, even overcast light with no sun patterns on the bottom
shots.composition: Looking straight down at about 80 degrees from a shore rock; the clear water and the stones beneath fill the whole frame, with a corner of grassy bank at the top left
shots.motion_elements: the ripples and light patterns moving over the submerged stones

shots.subject: Copper dwarf birch leaves on a low shrub at the lake shore, warm light shining through the leaves and the water glowing behind
shots.composition: Facing the low sun from two metres away; the backlit shrub fills the lower two thirds with glowing leaf edges and the bright water forms a soft band behind. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the dwarf birch leaves trembling and the glints on the water behind

shots.subject: A carpet of bright dark olive moss and small boulders at the edge of a tarn, the water surface dissolving into soft grey mist a few metres out
shots.composition: Slightly from above; the moss carpet and boulders fill the lower three quarters of the frame and the misty water fills only the top quarter. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the soft mist moving over the water

shots.subject: A gravel shoreline where tiny soft ripples lap gently over dark matte slate pebbles, no breaking waves, a tuft of sedge at one side and the lake fading to soft grey behind
shots.composition: From two metres away at knee height; the small breaking waves run across the middle of the frame, the wet pebbles fill the bottom and the sedge tuft touches the left edge. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the small waves breaking over the pebbles and the sedge tuft swaying

shots.subject: A small rivulet trickling over wet granite into the lake, glistening dark olive moss along its sides and the far shore blurred
shots.composition: The rivulet runs down through the middle of the frame from the top toward the lake at the bottom, a metre and a half from the camera, with mossy granite on both sides. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the rivulet trickling over the granite and the ripples where it enters the lake

shots.subject: Snow-loaded dwarf pine boughs hanging over open clear lake water from a granite ledge, their dark reflection rippling below
shots.composition: The boughs reach in from the right side about two metres away, the open water below them takes the lower half and a soft blurred far shore fills the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the reflection rippling on the open water and the pine needles moving slightly

shots.subject: Frost-covered grass blades on a lake bank glowing in low backlight, thin vapour rising from the open water behind
shots.composition: Camera low facing the rising sun; the frosted grass blades fill the bottom half three metres away with bright rims, and the steaming water is a soft glowing band behind. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the thin vapour rising from the water and the frosted grass blades moving slightly

shots.subject: A narrow rock crevice at the lake edge where small swells slosh gently in and out, old snow on the rocks on both sides
shots.composition: From two metres away slightly above; the crevice runs from the bottom centre up into the frame with dark rock and snow on both sides, and the open lake shows as a pale band at the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the small swells sloshing in and out of the crevice

shots.subject: A bleached driftwood log resting among reeds at a lake edge, the first snow on the log and pale mist over the water behind
shots.composition: The log lies horizontally across the lower half of the frame about three metres away, reeds rising around it and the misty water filling the top half. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the reeds swaying and the pale mist drifting over the water

shots.subject: Cracked plates of thin, smooth, wet melting ice on a lake surface with soft rounded grey edges, wide lanes of dark open water between them ruffled by a light breeze
shots.composition: Looking down at about 70 degrees from the shore; the ice plates and dark lanes fill the whole frame in an irregular mosaic, a strip of shore stones at the bottom edge
shots.motion_elements: the breeze ruffling the dark water in the wide open lanes and small ice fragments drifting slowly in them

shots.subject: Floating pondweed leaves and the tips of reeds on the surface of a quiet lake bay, warm light on the water
shots.composition: Looking down at about 65 degrees; the pondweed leaves are scattered across the lower and middle frame, the reed tips rise near the top, and warm light glints on the open water between them
shots.motion_elements: the slow ripples lifting the pondweed leaves and the reed tips swaying

shots.subject: Milky milky jade-gray glacial shallows over pale rippled silt and a few dark stones
shots.composition: Looking straight down from a boulder about two metres above the water; the milky shallows and the silt ripples fill the frame, the dark stones off centre
shots.motion_elements: the soft ripples moving across the milky water

shots.subject: An overhanging bank of grassy turf running along clear lake water, wet grass blades bending over the edge
shots.composition: From standing height a few metres along the bank; the turf edge runs diagonally from the lower left corner to the upper right, green grass on the left and clear water with visible stones on the right. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the wet grass blades swaying over the edge and the ripples on the clear water

shots.subject: A wind-ruffled patch of lake surface catching the warm sky, countless small ripples in gold and slate tones
shots.composition: Looking down and across the water from a shore rock; the rippled surface fills the whole frame with no horizon, the nearest ripples about three metres away. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the small wind ripples moving across the water and the shifting gold reflections

shots.subject: A dense stand of frost-touched reeds at a lake edge, grey water showing between the stems
shots.composition: The reed stand fills the frame from two metres away at eye level, vertical stems across the whole width with small gaps of grey water behind. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the reeds swaying in the breeze and the ripples in the gaps of water

shots.subject: Water curling smoothly over the rock lip of a lake outflow, a glassy sheet breaking into white ripples below, mist on the lake above the lip
shots.composition: From the side two metres away at the height of the lip; the glassy curve of water crosses the middle of the frame, the white ripples below fill the bottom and the misty lake surface the top. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the glassy water curling over the lip, the white ripples below and the mist over the lake

shots.subject: A seam where rust-brown and copper autumn moss meets a smooth weathered grey lakeside granite slab, softly mottled with lichen, not grainy, a thin clear trickle of water running along the seam toward the lake, a few fallen golden birch leaves on the moss
shots.composition: Looking slightly down from standing height; the moss-to-granite seam runs diagonally from the upper left to the lower right with the trickle along it, and a soft slice of blue lake fills the top corner. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the trickle of water running along the seam and the ripples on the slice of lake

shots.subject: Meltwater dripping and trickling from the edge of an overhanging bank of old snow into the lake, wet dark stones beneath
shots.composition: The snow overhang fills the top third about two metres away, the dripping meltwater falls through the middle and the rippled lake surface and stones fill the bottom. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the meltwater dripping and trickling from the snow edge and the small ripples where it lands

shots.subject: A slope of blooming alpine rhododendron and low grass above a lake, the blue water a soft band at the top
shots.composition: Slightly from above; the rhododendron shrubs fill the lower four fifths of the frame from a metre away and the blurred blue lake forms the top band. The main subject is one to five meters from the camera and fills most of the frame; anything behind it is only a soft, out-of-focus slice, never a sharp open vista or horizon.
shots.motion_elements: the rhododendron leaves and grass moving in the breeze and the ripples on the lake
